sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राजा राघवः प्रीतमानसः ।भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत् ।। ७.१०५.१४ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṁ rājā rāghavaḥ prītamānasaḥ ।bhojanaṁ munimukhyāya yathāsiddhamupāharat ।। 7.105.14 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that word, King Rama, with a pleased mind, offered food to the chief of sages as it was prepared.
